description:
Add an international phone input to your Bubble Native (mobile) app with country selection, automatic number formatting, dial code display, and built-in validation based on country phone patterns.

[table][url=https://zeroqode-native-demo-08.bubbleapps.io/api/1.1/mobile/preview?debug_mode=true&preview_view=Phone%20Number%20Input%20Free&utm_source=bubble_plugins_preview&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=PhoneNumberInputMobileFree][img=146x48]https://d999c2fb1571594aedf60232928d50bd.cdn.bubble.io/f1760696266390x919521590677568000/Frame%202121453246%20%282%29.svg[/img][/url]    [url=https://bubble.io/page?version=live&name=Phone+Number+Input+Free&id=zeroqode-native-demo-08&tab=Design&type=page&elements=bTKzz][img=160x48]https://d999c2fb1571594aedf60232928d50bd.cdn.bubble.io/f1760696263042x501545417158023800/Frame%202121453247%20%281%29.svg[/img][/url]    [url=https://docs.zeroqode.com/plugins/phone-number-input-mobile-free?utm_source=bubble_plugins_docs&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=PhoneNumberInputMobileFree][img=186x48]https://d999c2fb1571594aedf60232928d50bd.cdn.bubble.io/f1760696258261x636683117553803000/Frame%202121453248%20%282%29.svg[/img][/url][/table]

[size=4][b]⚡ Main Functions[/b][/size]

• [b]Automatic formatting & validation[/b]  
    Format the number based on the selected country’s phone pattern.
• [b]Country selector[/b]  
    Choose a country from a dropdown with flags and dial codes.

[size=4][b]⚡ Key Features[/b][/size]

[b]☎️ Dial code display[/b]  
      Show or hide international phone prefixes like +1 or +93.
[b]🎨 Placeholder color control[/b]  
      Define the color for visible text, including numbers and country details.
[b]✅ Validation states[/b]  
       Detect whether a phone number is valid for the selected country.

[size=5][b]FAQ[/b][/size]

[b]How do I add this plugin to my app?[/b]  
- Install the plugin, drag the Phone Number Input element onto your page, and configure its properties in the Bubble editor.

[b]Can users select their country when entering a phone number?[/b]  
- Yes. Users can choose a country from a dropdown, with the flag and dial code displayed automatically.

[b]Does the plugin format phone numbers automatically?[/b]  
- Yes. Phone numbers are formatted automatically based on the selected country.

[b]Is this plugin only for mobile apps?[/b]  
- Yes. It is designed specifically for Bubble Native mobile apps and is not intended for web applications.

[b]How can I check if a phone number is valid?[/b]  
- The plugin exposes validation states and events that indicate whether the entered number is valid.

[b]Do I need to write any code to use this plugin?[/b]  
- No. All setup and usage are handled through Bubble’s visual editor and workflows.
